Introduction
This document outlines the 
details equipment inspection steps I1, which must be performed on a monthly

Technical specification of 
Burner Mazout Pumps:
Item | Burner mazout pimps

Technical specification of Fuel 
Oil unloading Pumps
Item | Fuel oil unloading pumps
No. of fuel oil unloading pumps | 2
Type : of fuel oil unloading pumps | Screw spindle pump - series N55
Manufacture | KRAL - CZECH
Capacity | 946 L / min
Outlet pressure | 3 Bar
Relief valve internal 
 setting | 4 Bar
Fliid | mazout
Speed | 1450 RPM
Bearing type | Radial and thrust
Bearing no. | Fag 6311 / C3
Type of recommended oil | Mobil ISO VG # 46
Motor power | 11.4 kw
Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should cany the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets shoes, gloves, etc
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of tills pump
Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor of this pump
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery valve
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, manual puller.
Suitable lifting device feeler gauge.
Hammer, torque wrench,
 Dial indicator.
Work to be Carried Out
Steps | Works to be carried out | Reference Value | Test 
 Results
1. | Check any noise of the pump | 90 dB | 
2. | Check any vibration of the pump | 1.8 mm/s | 
3. | Check the amount of leakage from the 
 mechanical seal | OK - Not OK | 
4. | Check 
 any leakage of lubricating grease from bearing house of pump | OK - Not OK | 
5. | Check any leakage from the piping 
 connections to the pump | OK - Not OK | 
6. | Check the pressure in the pump's deliver | OK - Not OK | 
7. | Check the temperature of all bearing 
 houses. | <70 C | 
Steps | Works to be carried out | Reference Value | Test 
 Results
1. | Check the coupling bolts tightening | OK - Not OK | 
2. | Prevent the leakage of lubricating grease in bearing housing 
 of the pump | OK - Not OK | 
3. | Retighten the bolts connected pump and motor with foundation | OK - Not OK | 
4. | Check the alignment between pump and motor | OK - Not OK |
